title: Enterprise billing intake priority matrix and handshake process
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers regularly submit non-bug billing/packaging requests (commitment terms, invoice timing changes, marketplace credit allocations, custom cost tags) that require cross-functional review. Current intake is ad-hoc (email + tickets) resulting in slow SLAs, inconsistent decisions, and revenue leakage. Goal: define a repeatable priority matrix and a lightweight "handshake" process that routes requests to the right lane (Sales/RevOps, Finance, Legal, or Engineering), enforces decision authority, and provides SLAs and audit artifacts. This ticket scopes the PM side of the playbook: decision lanes, triage form fields, required artifacts, approval thresholds, and escalation paths. Engineering work to implement forms/automation is in ENG-8420. Finance policy updates tracked in PM-46211.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A documented priority matrix (Urgent Sales Commitments / Standard Billing Changes / Marketplace Credit Requests / Cost Allocation Tags) published in Confluence with examples for each lane
A2: A 1-page intake form template (Google Form + optional structured webhook) with mandatory fields that implement the matrix decisions
A3: Clear decision authority table (who can approve credits, who needs Finance sign-off, when Legal input is required)
A4: SLA targets defined per lane (e.g., 24h ack for urgent, 5 business days decision for standard), with ownership and fallback rules
A5: A lightweight audit artifact (tagged ticket + PDF of approvals) is created for every approved financial adjustment
A6: Handshake process defined: acknowledgements, estimated delivery date, and follow-up handoff to Operations or Billing Engineering
discussion: 2026-03-10 — Aisha Patel: Initial write-up and problem statement posted. Key pain: sales waits for credit approvals during closing; revenue ops often lacks cost-allocation tags. Proposed: 3 priority lanes + explicit sign-off thresholds.

2026-03-11 — Diego Martinez: Added intake form field list. Suggested mandatory fields: customer account ID, commitment tier, affected invoices, requested effective date, justification, expected ARR impact, legal required?

2026-03-11 — Priya Rao (Finance): Finance requests that any credit > $10k must include a finance worksheet and require VP-Finance sign-off. Also recommends a separate flow for marketplace adjustment credits to preserve marketplace reconciliation.

2026-03-12 — Leo Huang (Sales Ops): Pointed out that sales needs a TTR < 8 hours for renewals tied to closure; proposed an \"Urgent Sales Commitments\" lane with 8h SLA and automated escalation to RevOps on timeout.

2026-03-12 — Samira El-Rashidi (Legal): Legal input required only when contract terms are being changed or when invoice language is amended; otherwise legal review to be optional with 3 business day SLA when requested.

2026-03-13 — Diego Martinez: Drafted handshake protocol: (1) Intake ack within SLA window, (2) Assigned owner and queue, (3) Decision artefact (email + ticket update) recorded, (4) Finance/RevOps executes adjustments and files a PDF audit. Linked draft in Confluence.
2026-03-13 — Aisha Patel: Review requested from Revenue leadership and Billing Eng; scheduled working sync on 2026-03-16 to finalize thresholds and automation acceptance criteria.
decisions: D1: Adopt 4 triage lanes: Urgent Sales Commitments, Standard Billing Changes, Marketplace Credit Requests, Cost Allocation Tagging
D2: Thresholds: credits <= $1,000 can be approved by RevOps lead; $1,001–10,000 require Finance manager; > $10,000 require VP-Finance
D3: SLA targets: Urgent = 8 hours to decision/ack; Standard = 5 business days; Marketplace = 3 business days; Cost tags = 10 business days
D4: All approved financial adjustments must include an audit PDF and a cost-allocation tag to be created in the billing system
D5: Intake form will be a Google Form initially with structured fields; ENG-8420 to implement a formal API/webhook-based intake in Q2
D6: Export of intake metadata to a dedicated billing queue in the Console (release console-2026.04) for visibility
